title: e-File Pinpoint
setup: Black's queen stands on e7, right in front of its own king, and the e-file below it is open.
hint: When the queen shields its king, it becomes a sitting target.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Re1}} pins the queen to the king on e8. The queen cannot step off the e-file without exposing its king, and your king on f2 guards e1, so fighting back with {{Qxe1+}} gives the queen for a rook after {{Kxe1}}. Every other reply loses the queen too.

A pinned piece is not really a piece: it is a target.
